static_traits.name: Zhao Lei
static_traits.social_status: Has supportive family and a few friends, but they do not really understand the schedule and the resulting social isolation
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problems experienced; no psychotherapy received; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly, highly cooperative, can describe triggering situations and automatic thoughts specifically; tone rather neutral but low mood; thinking often shows catastrophizing, mental filtering, predicting the future, and black-and-white patterns

basic_info.main_problem: Due to long-term overnight night shifts, having almost no social life; believing one will always be lonely and in pain, with overall well-being and mental health significantly affected.
basic_info.core_demands: Seeking counseling because loneliness and isolation significantly affect overall well-being and mental health; hoping to alleviate these feelings, challenge negative beliefs, and form more realistic views.
growth_experiences: Started overnight night-shift work at a hotel about a year ago; initially moderate stress, but over time, as the schedule became severely mismatched with others', social isolation gradually worsened; feelings intensify on weekends when seeing others socialize (offline events and social media); tried joining online groups and attending social activities, but the unstable schedule and fatigue made it hard to sustain connections.

core_beliefs: I will grow old lonely and remain in pain
Having no regular social life means being unhappy

special_situations.event: Seeing others' offline socializing and lively scenes on weekends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am unable to socialize on weekends like most people, I am destined to lose relationships and end up lonely
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to attend social activities or join online groups, but struggling to maintain consistency due to schedule and energy limits
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will always be alone; the future will not change

special_situations.event: Browses friends' social media updates and sees others' active social lives
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Others all have social lives while I have none, which shows my life is a failure socially
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing offline contact, turning to online attempts at connection, but quickly giving up due to fatigue and mismatch
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as them; I can never fit in

special_situations.event: Overnight night shifts causing the schedule to be severely mismatched with most people's
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only people with 'normal' schedules can have stable social lives and intimate relationships; otherwise it is impossible to build connections
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Barely arranges activities during the day or tries to adjust, but often reduces participation due to fatigue
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My schedule is destined to make me lose socializing and relationships

special_situations.event: Persistent fatigue and decreased drive (daytime hours after night shifts)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: When I feel terrible it means reality is terrible, and social life will not improve either
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing outings and social attempts, buffering discomfort by passively waiting to recover energy
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am so exhausted now; things can only get worse and worse

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be understood and to have stable, intimate social connections
core_conflict.fear: Fearing long-term loneliness, being ignored, and being unable to build relationships
defense_goal: Maintaining psychological security on the grounds that 'the schedule cannot be changed'

object_relations.self_representation: An isolated outsider, hard to be understood
object_relations.object_representation: Others/the world as a group that is hard to approach and does not understand the schedule and situation

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked 'what evidence supports that you will always be lonely' or invited to look for counter-evidence
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to view the current schedule as a decisive obstacle, believing change is almost impossible (fading reality into a single conclusion)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In a flat but firm tone, repeating the reasons for schedule mismatch; using absolute statements (e.g. 'there is no way to change it', 'it will definitely be like this'), downplaying alternative possibilities, with little emotional expression but emphasizing practical constraints.

manifestations: Overnight night shifts causing schedule mismatch with most people, making relationships hard to maintain
Loneliness significantly worsens on weekends when seeing others socialize and social media updates
Subjectively anticipating that the future will always be lonely and painful
outcomes: Low mood affecting life outside of work

exception_events.target_problem: On weekends or when seeing others socialize on social media, the client usually falls into the prophetic thinking of 'I will grow old lonely', and reduces attempts to actively reach out and participate socially.
exception_events.unique_outcome: At the stage of having just joined certain online groups, the client proactively posted and interacted with others, got to know several new friends, and for a time felt more optimistic, experiencing the feeling of 'changing my situation and regaining control'.
exception_events.reason: Clue: adopted a different approach (actively joining and interacting via posts), gaining immediate responses and connection; the client felt actively changing the situation with a sense of control, hence this more optimistic, more engaged exception.

positive_force: Able to act proactively and experience a sense of control when joining online groups
Having certain social resources (supportive family and a few friends)
Work performance stable, basic life functioning not yet affected
negative_force: Cognitive patterns such as catastrophizing, black-and-white thinking, mental filtering, and predicting the future worsen the sense of hopelessness
Night-shift schedule mismatched with most people's, causing fatigue and difficulty with consistency
Loneliness reinforced, triggering decreased drive, further reducing socializing attempts

target_behavior.behavior: Catastrophic and prophetic automatic thoughts of 'I will grow old lonely' appearing on weekends and when browsing social media, accompanied by low mood and social avoidance
antecedent: Seeing others' offline social scenes on weekends
Exhaustion after long-term all-night shifts and low daytime energy
target_behavior.core_reason: Viewing the night-shift schedule as a decisive obstacle, forming black-and-white and future-predicting beliefs, treating subjective emotions as objective reality and reinforcing hopelessness
target_behavior.function: In the short term, escaping disappointment and social discomfort, lowering expectations for self-protection
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood and decreased drive, further reducing socializing attempts and relationship-maintaining behaviors, maintaining the isolated state
